description: MCP tools Jev advertised directly for a turn (TUI tool-usage stats).

noMatch.description: `true` when Jev found no relevant tools.

node.description: Strategy step (node) that was active for this turn.

scores.description: Strategy-adjusted probability per advertised tool, sorted descending.

skipReason.description: Human-readable reason Jev did not run this turn (fail-open skip). `None` when Jev produced a suggestion or is disabled in config.

strategy.description: Strategy name when a `/plan <strategy>` harness tuned the ranking.

threadId.description: Optional thread target when the suggestion applies to a specific thread.

tools.description: Tools advertised directly for this turn, as `server/tool`.

title: JevToolSuggestionNotification
